name: read
description:
Read a file or list a directory.

- `path` may be absolute or relative to the working directory.
- Returns up to 2000 lines from `offset` (1-indexed). Each line is prefixed `<n>: `; that prefix is not part of the file — never copy it into an edit.
- For a later section, call again with a larger offset. Prefer one large read over many 30-line slices.
- Lines over 2000 characters are cut. Use grep to find content in large files.
- Directories come back one entry per line, subdirectories with a trailing `/`.
- Read several files in parallel when you already know you need them.
